blocks.text: Eventually the Turks break and recoil, and the Guru comes back among the fallen, wiping faces, looking upon the dead, and blessing the field of sacrifice. (33–38)
One surviving Sikh asks not for worldly reward but for the undoing of the old written renunciation, the torn disclaimer that had once severed formal allegiance under pressure. (39)
The Guru takes out the paper, accepts the request, and praises the selfless act, turning the battle into both repentance and restoration for those who had returned through death to fidelity. (40)
